title: Linear Algebra & Calculus
description: Master essential engineering mathematics with this comprehensive course covering linear algebra, multivariable calculus, and series representations. Designed specifically for B.Tech and engineering students, this course walks you through critical topics including Gauss elimination, matrix eigenvalue problems, partial differentiation, double and triple integrals, and Fourier series expansions. Gain the foundational problem-solving skills needed to solve complex engineering models, compute volumes and centers of mass, and evaluate function representations with clarity and confidence.
